title: Budget-first student persona
content:
Persona: Aarav, 19, first-year college student living in a hostel. Monthly food budget under Rs 3,000, splits orders with roommates, checks prices before anything else.
Needs: lowest price per meal, combo deals, free-delivery thresholds, student discounts.
Pains: surprise delivery fees, small portions for the price, apps that hide the total until checkout.
Messaging:
- Headline: The cheapest meals on campus.
- Proof: show the saving next to every price.
- Offer: combos and free delivery over Rs 150.
- Tone: friendly, direct, a little cheeky.
rationale: Positioning 'Cheap' for college students means price and savings must lead every message, so the persona is framed around budget pain points.
